o.text: From Arabic قِيَاسِيّ (qiyāsiyy). By surface analysis, qiyas + -i

From bayram + -lıq.
Cognate with Turkish bayramlık (Ottoman Turkish بیراملق). Compare also Kazakh айттық (ayttıq), Uzbek hayitlik, which are built on Arabic عِيد (ʕīd).
